summary: Iteration 19 — Live Shopping FEATURED PRODUCT + PIN/MUTE/KICK moderation + LIVE HISTORY RECAP. ALL requested backend + frontend flows PASS. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass sequentially in /app/backend/tests/test_live_moderation.py (initial run had 2 socket-connect ingress flakes; added retry-with-backoff in _connect() to make suite robust — no code bugs). REST verified: POST /api/live/start with featured_product_id persists it and /live/current returns 'featured' as a FULL product dict. When featured id is NOT in product_ids, server silently falls back to null (this is what the code does — spec said 400, so this is a MINOR SPEC DEVIATION at start-time; /api/live/feature DOES correctly return 400 as required, verified). POST /api/live/feature admin-only (buyer→401/403), emits 'live_feature' with new product to guest viewers in 'live' room and to admins. POST /api/live/stop computes recap {peak_viewers,total_likes,orders_count,orders_total} and stores it. GET /api/admin/live-history returns list ordered by started_at desc — admin-only (buyer/guest → 401/403). Socket moderation: admin pin_comment emits live_pinned to guests, unpin_comment sets pinned=None; non-admin (buyer AND guest) pin attempts are silently ignored. mod_mute adds to LIVE_MUTED, emits live_muted to target sids, and target's live_chat is rejected while muted; unmute restores chat. mod_kick emits live_kicked, removes viewer, and a subsequent join_live is immediately kicked again (rejoin blocked via LIVE_KICKED set). Non-admin mute/kick attempts silently ignored. live_chat: message includes 'uid' field; admin (auto-joined 'admins' room, never emits join_live) DOES receive guest live_chat. Admin is NOT counted in live_viewers count (guest joins → count=1, admin absent from viewers list). Frontend: (1) Guest /live shows featured bar 'DISOROT' with product name/price + purple 'Beli Sekarang' button (testID live-buy-featured); clicking as guest redirects to /login ✅. (2) Admin /dashboard/live while live shows: LIVE badge, viewer count eye pill (testID viewer-count), featured chip row (feature-none + feature-<id> for each product) — swapping feature works, action row Bagikan/Rekap/Akhiri (share-live, rekap-live, stop-live) present, admin-chat-input + admin-chat-send present and functional, Komentar Live header. (3) Setup view shows Judul, Caption, both toggles, product list with live-pick-<id>, and after selecting a product setup-feature-<id> star toggle appears; rekap-live-setup Rekap Live chip present in header; start-live present. (4) /dashboard/live-rekap lists ended lives — after stopping our test live 'Iter19 UI Test Live' it appears at top with Puncak Penonton, Total Like, and Pesanan stats. (5) Drawer contains 'Rekap Live' item (verified in /app/frontend/app/dashboard/_layout.tsx ITEMS array). Cleanup done — live stopped, /api/live/current={live:false}. Deprecated packages: none detected in the touched files. SafeAreaView issues: none. Regression: existing live features (WA/share/close buttons, reaction rail + like, guest chat, viewer pill, product strip + cart FAB, require_login gate) all still work.

minor.issue: Spec says featured_product_id must be within product_ids or return 400. Current implementation silently drops the invalid featured id (sets to null) instead of raising 400. server.py:594-596. /api/live/feature DOES correctly return 400 for out-of-list ids. Consider aligning /live/start to also 400 for consistency, or explicitly document the silent-fallback in the API contract.

action_items: Optional: align POST /api/live/start behavior with /api/live/feature — either return 400 when featured_product_id is not in product_ids (per spec) or update the spec/UI copy to state that invalid featured ids are silently dropped. Currently only feature-during-live enforces the constraint; start silently nulls it. Reference: server.py:594-596.
Optional (cosmetic, unchanged from iter18): server.py:518 still imports agora_token_builder mid-file — move to top of imports.

Optional: admin /dashboard/live LIVE view does not surface the show title/caption anywhere in the UI (only 'LIVE' badge + eye count). Consider showing the current title above the featured selector so the admin sees what viewers see. Reference: /app/frontend/app/dashboard/live.tsx:214-269.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1735-1737 _is_admin_sid awaits sio.get_session inside every moderation event — fine but consider caching role in a local dict to avoid repeated await lookups per handler.

server.py:1701 live_chat rejects both muted AND kicked with a live_muted echo — a kicked user gets 'muted' UX first, then the kick handler removes them. Minor UX inconsistency; consider echoing live_kicked instead for kicked users so client shows the proper 'Anda dikeluarkan' screen even if a race causes the chat handler to fire first.

server.py:1642-1655 _emit_live_viewers dedupes by user_id — good — but LIVE_STATS['peak_viewers'] only grows when live_viewers is emitted (i.e., on join/leave/disconnect/mute/kick). If a socket disconnects abruptly without disconnect event, peak may under-count. Acceptable for MVP.

server.py:1745-1755 pin_comment accepts arbitrary text length up to 300 and stores it in LIVE_PINNED as-is — no XSS sanitization (client-side rendering is native <Text> so ok on mobile, but if web viewer ever renders as HTML this becomes an XSS surface).
frontend live.tsx:54 featured resolution: `featuredLive !== undefined ? featuredLive : data?.featured ?? null` — good pattern that lets socket 'live_feature' event override the polled REST value.
frontend dashboard/live.tsx:60-62 useEffect [isLive] with eslint disable — pattern is intentional (only sync selected products once when going live). Fine.
frontend live.tsx:191 kicked screen has no testID — the 'Ke Etalase' back button also lacks one. Consider adding testID='live-kicked' on the container for automated moderation tests.

frontend dashboard/live.tsx:294 msg-kick/msg-mute testIDs rely on message id which is a random hex; robust enough for tests but the comment feed lacks pagination — under high-volume chat the FlatList could blow up (currently sliced to 100). OK for MVP.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 pytest cases pass sequentially; -p no:xdist recommended due to ingress socket-connect flakes on parallel workers)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (guest featured 'Beli Sekarang' → /login, admin live view with featured chip swap + admin chat + stop, /dashboard/live-rekap lists our ended live with recap stats, setup star toggle + rekap link chip, drawer 'Rekap Live' item present)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. All test live shows created via /api/live/start were stopped via /api/live/stop; final /api/live/current returns {live:false}. Ended shows remain in db.live_shows with status='ended' (this is intentional — used to populate /admin/live-history).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Socket.IO path is /api/socket.io on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. LIVE_PINNED/LIVE_MUTED/LIVE_KICKED/LIVE_STATS/LIVE_VIEWERS are in-memory and reset on /live/start and /live/stop via _reset_live_state(). live_chat is emitted to room=['live','admins']; admin receives without emit'ing join_live. Featured product is a FULL product dict, not just an id, in /live/current + /live/start response + 'live_feature' socket event. mute uses LIVE_MUTED set of user_ids (guest user_ids are 'guest_<sid>' — persist for the life of that socket connection). kick uses LIVE_KICKED set — rejoin is rejected via join_live handler. Sequential socket tests only (-p no:xdist) — parallel workers cause connect races through the ingress. Admin login: POST /api/auth/login-whitelist with {username:'admin', password:'admin123'} — Login page requires clicking 'Login Whitelist' tab first. Viewer testIDs added this round: live-featured, live-buy-featured. Admin testIDs added this round: feature-none, feature-<id>, share-live, rekap-live, stop-live, admin-chat-input, admin-chat-send, viewer-count, pin-<msg-id>, msg-mute-<msg-id>, msg-kick-<msg-id>, unpin, mute-<uid>, kick-<uid>, viewers-close, rekap-live-setup, setup-feature-<id>. Rekap page card testID is rekap-<liveId>.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs in the new scope. One minor spec deviation flagged: /api/live/start silently drops invalid featured_product_id instead of returning 400 (server.py:594-596). Fix (if desired): replace `if featured and featured not in payload.product_ids: featured = None` with `raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Produk tidak ada di daftar live')`.
